Raja Karuppan Chetty, an employee of educationist and philanthropist Meena Muthiah who passed away in May 2026. The court's order was prompted by a complaint alleging that Mr. Chetty misappropriated ₹800 crore belonging to the Chettinad family through his close relationship with Ms. Muthiah.  The inquiry, which must conclude swiftly due to the deceased's role as secretary of Kumara Rajah Muthiah School of Traditional Arts & Crafts, is expected to investigate allegations of criminal conspiracy, forgery, and financial mismanagement.

recent_articles.title: Bid to ‘sell’ train seat: Surat court reduces railway porter’s jail term from 1 month to 2 days | Ahmedabad News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: An additional sessions court in Surat reduced the jail sentence of Raghu Dayma, a railway porter convicted for illegally selling a train seat, from one month to two days. The court also increased the fine amount from Rs 500 to Rs 1,500.  The court's decision came after an appeal filed by Dayma, who was initially sentenced by the Judicial Magistrate First Class (Railways) court in Surat. **Kamal Saiyed**, a senior correspondent for The Indian Express, reported on the case and provided context about the court proceedings.

recent_articles.title: Hooch deaths: 4 Pune Rural cops suspended for being in contact with key accused | Pune News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the tragic deaths linked to methanol-laced illicit liquor, **the Pune Rural police** suspended four constables who were allegedly in contact with key accused Radheshyam Prajapati.  The investigation into the incident is being handled by the Maharashtra CID and has resulted in the arrest of several suspects, including Karnelsingh Virka, his son Gurmangatsingh, Yogesh Ramchandra Vhankade (alias Sikandar Rathod), Radheshyam Prajapati, and Kalpesh Agrawal.  The state excise department has also registered three cases related to this incident. The investigation is ongoing, with authorities examining potential links between the deaths and other reported incidents of methanol-laced liquor consumption.

recent_articles.title: Norse Atlantic Airways Offers Dirt-Cheap Tickets. There’s a Catch | WIRED
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Norse Atlantic Airways**, a low-cost airline, has faced criticism for its customer service practices. The company relies heavily on AI agents to handle inquiries, but complaints have emerged about the lack of human intervention and potential scams associated with this approach.  Customers report being unable to reach live representatives, encountering fraudulent websites and phone numbers, and facing financial losses after interacting with these systems. While **Norse Atlantic Airways** claims its AI agent Freya has been successful in managing customer inquiries, many customers have reported difficulties obtaining refunds or resolving issues through the company's automated system.  The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) is aware of the complaints and suggests that consumers may consider filing claims with their state attorney general's office for further investigation.

recent_articles.title: Release of 14 abducted Kukis ‘cancelled’ after protests in Manipur - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The United Naga Council (UNC)** cancelled the planned release of 14 Kuki civilians in Manipur on Monday, June 1, 2026, after protests by a section of Nagas. The **UNC**, which represents Nagas in Manipur, stated that the release was called off due to "prevailing sentiments of the Naga public" following protestors' demands for the simultaneous release of six abducted Nagas.  The hostage crisis began after the killing of three church leaders on May 13th and resulted in a previous exchange of hostages between Kuki and Naga groups.

recent_articles.title: Accused Dies In Encounter After Assam Attack Leaves 1 Dead, Girl Critical
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Roz Ali**, the main accused in the Assam murder case, died during a police operation following his arrest.  The incident occurred after 19-year-old Madhurjya Barman and a 17-year-old girl were attacked while returning home. **Madhurjya Barman** was associated with the Paschim Nalbari Regional Students' Union, while the injured teenage girl remains under treatment.  The Assam Police are continuing their investigation into the case.

recent_articles.title: Ukraine’s forcibly transferred children must not be a bargaining chip | Child Rights | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Russia** has been accused of forcibly transferring over 20,000 Ukrainian children to its territory since the invasion began in 2014. International investigations have found these transfers were unlawful under international humanitarian law, and despite warrants issued by the International Criminal Court and findings from the European Court of Human Rights, **Russia** has not returned them. The situation has driven families to desperate measures, including risky missions by NGOs like Save Ukraine.  The Ukrainian government, along with international partners, are working to establish a comprehensive tracing mechanism, intensify legal efforts against Russian officials, and fully implement sanctions on **Russia**.

recent_articles.title: ‘Old enough to pull trigger’: Delhi teen dies 4 days after being shot, family demands minor accused be tried as adult | The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A 17-year-old boy, who was shot in the head outside a Delhi eatery on May 27th while with a friend, died from his injuries on Monday. **The victim's family** demanded that one of the accused, a 16-year-old juvenile, be tried as an adult.  **The Delhi Police Crime Branch** is investigating the case and is expected to add murder charges to the existing FIR. Two other suspects, aged 18 and 24, were arrested for the murder. An automatic pistol was recovered from the juvenile's possession.
